mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_delivery_outbox (event_key, run_id, event_type, destination_type, destination_ref, payload_json, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{runId}, #{eventType}, #{destinationType}, #{destinationRef}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM fbs_delivery_outbox WHERE destination_type = #{destinationType} AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= NOW())) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_delivery_outbox SET status = 'LEASED', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND destination_type = #{destinationType} AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT') AND next_attempt_at <= NOW()) OR (status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until <= NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key, run_id, event_type, destination_type, destination_ref, payload_json, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_token, lease_until, last_http_status, last_error, version, create_time, update_time FROM fbs_delivery_outbox WHERE lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'LEASED' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, event_key, run_id, event_type, destination_type, destination_ref, payload_json, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_token, lease_until, last_http_status, last_error, version, create_time, update_time FROM fbs_delivery_outbox WHERE id = #{id} AND destination_type = 'INTERNAL_DISPATCHER' AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_until > NOW() FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fbs_delivery_outbox SET lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until > NOW()

UPDATE fbs_delivery_outbox SET status = 'CONSUMED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until > NOW()

UPDATE fbs_delivery_outbox SET status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until > NOW()

UPDATE fbs_delivery_outbox SET status = 'DEAD', lease_owner = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'LEASED' AND lease_until > NOW()
